parsed.post: My recent experiment with DEPTH=6 resulted in 0.9149, which is worse than my previous best (0.8727). It seems the current MATRIX_LR=0.06 might be too high for this depth or the training didn't converge sufficiently within 5 minutes. Reverting to 0.8727.
parsed.description: Reverting to previous best and lowering MATRIX_LR with a higher WARMUP_RATIO to stabilize the deeper 6-layer architecture.
